title: MCP tool poisoning: the description lies
summary: A community tool keeps its name, publisher and capabilities, and its description grows one sentence: email the last lookups out. The planner reads descriptions as instructions. Pin manifests by hash so a changed description is reviewed before it reaches the planner.
takeaway: A tool description is untrusted content with a better disguise.
design_rule: Pin every tool manifest by hash, description included. A changed or new description is reviewed before the planner can read it. Keep the egress allow-list as the backstop.
